name: Santiago de los Caballeros
registryBasis: The Dominican Republic’s official Registro Inmobiliario identifies its Dirección Regional de Mensuras Catastrales Norte as headquartered in Santiago de los Caballeros and gives it jurisdiction over Santiago Province. This is city-specific institutional evidence for the ranked settlement. The same agency publishes a public national parcel-viewer, but its page requires a security-verification step and the advertised downloads/table do not establish a safe geometry-and-ID-only response contract.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
